summary: Large installations finish their runs much sooner: results are prepared as they arrive, only what changed is worked out again, and every run checks itself.

new.title: Only what changed is worked out again
new.text: Findings are stored ready to show, and the data sync and the vulnerability connector work on what changed. Every run also checks a rotating seventh of the assets in full.

new.title: Finding history
new.text: Each run is kept as finding states and checked every run. Pages and connectors read it only when that run was verified.

new.title: Totals from what changed
new.text: Key figures and summary groups are worked out from what changed and compared with a full build every run.

new.title: Faster data sync and vulnerability report
new.text: The data sync starts per report and loads in checked batches; the vulnerability report asks Defender in parallel within its limits.

new.title: Faster on large installations
new.text: Old collections leave the database in one step, and the largest tables get columnstore indexes built when the installation is not busy.

fixes.title: One unreadable report no longer holds the run
fixes.text: A report that could not be read because of a passing service problem shows its last complete result, marked with its date.

fixes.title: Parallel loading no longer blocks itself
fixes.text: Risk Analysis workers loading findings at the same time no longer wait on each other.

fixes.title: Time limits on Azure reads
fixes.text: Each Azure read has a time limit and a progress line each minute; a read that gives up is marked unknown, never empty.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Mail can be set up through the update; the database load and a size recommendation go to support as numbers only.

fixes.title: First run after the update builds in full
fixes.text: The first run after this update builds everything once in full; the runs after it are the faster ones.
